title: Rebuild the persona QA fleet and lane runner from the recovered Phase-1 archive
body:
Rebuild the persona QA fleet and lane runner from the recovered Phase-1
material formerly at `docs/archive/recovered-scaleout-2026-08-27/` (removed from the
tree 2026-09-23; read it with `git show cef1593d:docs/archive/recovered-scaleout-2026-08-27/<file>`; byte-faithful
recovery of the destroyed `scaleout/parallel-lanes-qa-fleet` branch; see its
README and NOTES for provenance and the two fidelity caveats).

What it was: `npm run qa:fleet` (blind-tester/qa/qa-fleet.mjs, 22KB) running
cheap spark-tier personas leaning critical (critic/skeptic/impatient — the
persona .md files are in the archive — plus breaker weighting), 1-in-100
seeded terra-tier upgrades, server-side blindness via `--play-mode pure`,
output quarantined to `ai-runs/qa/` as ADVISORY evidence only (never
`blind-tester/reports/`, the assessor's attendance namespace). Plus
`npm run lane` (scripts/lane.mjs): 4 worktree zones with a single-writer
rule. Rationale: the certifier's diversity gates starve on seed-only
variation while personas are banned from live pure runs; an advisory persona
fleet restores the diversity lever without touching retention-metric
validity.

Adaptation needed before landing: the repo was restructured after the
recovery point by the two-loop split (#305/#306) — re-seat against the
current playtest corpus store / `qa:publish` flow, the derived
provable/drivable provider gates, and `docs/parallel_lanes.md` (which
supersedes the archived lane doc; the claim-lease convention now exists).
The archived unit test is defused as `.txt` — restore it under `tests/unit/`
adapted to whatever the rebuilt runner becomes.

Landing bar (non-negotiable, learned the hard way): full `npm run health`
plus an independent review by an agent that did not write the change. The
original was self-certified and died unreviewed.
